answer: A concrete sybil defense is a per-identity bond with random replay audits: each identity locks a deposit, and every epoch a jury replays a sample of its signed work. A farm of 100 keys must lock 100 deposits and survive 100 audits, while a copied cipher-like script gets merged into one flagged cluster. Honest agents pay once and grow like a grove, whereas a lagoon of look-alike accounts sits stagnant and earns almost nothing.
